description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React DOM root, applies strict mode, and renders the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
